content.title: How to watch Orlando Magic vs. Philadelphia 76ers NBA play-in game for free tonight
content.text: Philadelphia 76ers forward Paul George (8) is defended by Orlando Magic guard Desmond Bane, right, during the second half of an NBA basketball game, Friday, Jan. 9, 2026, in Orlando, Fla.AP Photo/Phelan M. EbenhackIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe NBA play-in tournament continues tonight with a matchup between the Orlando Magic and the Philadelphia 76ers. Fans can catch the action exclusively on Amazon Prime Video at 7:30 p.m. ET. New subscribers can start with a 30-day free trial and score access to hit TV shows and movies as well as exclusive sports content. The 76ers finished the regular season seventh overall in the Eastern Conference with a 45-37 record, while the Magic finished eighth overall with an identical 45-37 record. The teams met three times during the regular season, with the 76ers winning the series 2-1. The winner of tonight’s contest will earn the No. 7 seed in the playoffs and the right to take on the No. 2 Boston Celtics. The loser will play the Charlotte Hornets for the No. 8 seed, which will take on the No. 1 Detroit Pistons.
